sampler: reuse B20 physical-window order; clean/background per physical window; no outcome-dependent resampling
scheduler: MultiStepLR milestones=[600], gamma=0.1, applied after each update; no reduced-LR update before final
backend: Math SDPA, Flash and memory-efficient disabled
action_loss: official unweighted mean L1 over all8x7 valid values
normalization: same20train action/proprio statistics as B20; same AE-C train-only center statistics for C/D targets
stage: joint action and auxiliary, no additional RLA-only updates
randomness: same initial CPU/CUDA/Python/NumPy state and official stochastic graph for C/D; added RLA draws need not reproduce B20 random consumption after step0
selection: final600 only, no early stopping or budget extension
